name: The Last Laugh
summary: Delphine's Thread of Fate: the Confrontation.

stages.journal: Delphine's story will come to a head in an Act III chapter.
stages.hint: Keep Delphine with the party, or at camp, and rest once the chapter is done.

waits.text: Delphine will want a word at camp once that chapter is behind us.

stages.journal: On Fool's Day Delphine took the stage from the Fool himself, and wrote her own ending to his rhyme.
